genus_comparison: Separate E. eriantha in sect. Poinsettia from E. exstipulata (text reference), E. heterophylla, E. cyathophora, E. marginata and E. bicolor. Long alternate, needlelike green leaves; whitish densely hairy gland-fringe HOOD, large hairy mottled fruit versus white-margined bract pair.
scientific_limits: No verified macro showing 5–12 fine hairy gland appendage fingers folding over an actual gland; no verified detached mature 2.8–4.1 mm pitted/tuberculate carunculate seed at scale. Photo arrows only on external fruit, cyathium groups, narrow foliage and branching form. Whole rooted habit/photo scale missing.
native_range: Texas native at state level from POWO, but target county provenance not independently verified. No update to native-metrics or county-only rules. Avoid implying a Hays county native occurrence.
